scope_items.item: Scenario S3 runs end to end against moto: policy create, group create, user create, add to group, attach, access key create; the secret key appears only in the confirmed iam_access_key_create response
iam_access_key_create and STS credential-issuing tools refuse without confirm=true, and no other tool's output contains a SecretAccessKey or the configured credentials
Scenario S8 tools (iam_group_remove_user, iam_policy_detach, iam_access_key_update/delete) refuse in read-only mode, and destructive ones require confirm=true
respx tests confirm ValidatePolicy and GetUserMFA are sent as signed form POSTs with Version=2010-05-08, and the parsed XML comes back as JSON
Every IAM/STS tool in PRD section 6 has a passing unit test

edge_cases.description: Invalid policy JSON is refused before any network call
STS duration_seconds outside 900..43,200 refused before the call
mfa_serial given without mfa_code (or the reverse) is refused
user_name and all_users both given on iam_access_key_list is refused
Virtual MFA seeds and QR codes stripped from list and GetUserMFA outputs
Missing login profile vs missing user told apart by matching 'login profile' in the NoSuchEntity message; a different Wasabi message wording would surface an error instead of {configured: false}
iam_mfa_device_list silently ignores assignment_status when user_name is given
The root AssumeRole hint is appended to every AccessDenied from AssumeRole, not only root calls
